speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — answer the amber one (v6)
description: v6. Opens on the chime: the top-middle cell turns amber and the camera pushes in from that frame, the answer lands inside seven seconds, and the pull-out runs under the first line. The diff is reached the way it is really reached - six cells, enlarge one, open its diff. See mulmoterminal-60s-v6-NOTES.md.

beats.text: This is a terminal with agents in it. Six cells, six real ptys — and the agents are the ones that ask questions. Amber means one needs you, and only amber chimes.
